hero.descriptionLine1: "Giving medicine an extra pair of Eyes, giving patients an extra layer of Safety."
hero.descriptionLine2: Y Nhãn is an "AI pair of eyes" that helps hospitals continuously observe patients without physical contact, detecting risks early and improving treatment safety.
hero.heroImageAlt: A doctor caringly attending to a patient in a hospital bed

problem.title: The Challenge in Healthcare
problem.description: Doctors can't be with every patient 24/7. But AI can always be watching. Y Nhãn doesn't replace doctors — it becomes a technological companion, helping detect risks early and reduce caregiving pressure.

architecture.title: AI System Architecture
architecture.description: An advanced image data analysis model with high accuracy.

about.description: Vietnamese healthcare technology, made for the Vietnamese people. VICARE develops AI solutions to improve healthcare quality and support medical staff through artificial intelligence.
